claim: a routing is CARRIED only when an ACTIVE entry reaches its consumer. NO_ENTRY (path works, nothing routed) and NO_DELIVERY (entry exists, cannot arrive) are reported apart because they need different work. A lesson can also act from a consumer the objective did not name, and that is reported separately rather than counted as coverage. A rule live in the code path with no entry behind it is reported as live_rules_with_no_entry - it is worse than an empty routing, not better, because it cannot be reviewed or retired
